reason: A well-known Croatian coffee and tea brand with its own webshop, a verified Instagram profile with Croatian content, and product pages with clear facts (pack size, servings, price).
audience: Adults aged 20–40 in Croatia who enjoy a sweet coffee moment at home or at work and like trying new flavours.
goals: Awareness of the new Cappuccino Tiramisu flavour, more saves and comments, and visits to the webshop.
inspiration: Warm, cosy home moments with coffee and dessert; short, friendly copy.
